OPS-004.summary: Sessions and removal: status is now done, proven by a named journey over the launch HTTP doors.

OPS-005.summary: Erasure is final: Base's operator status and role routes refuse any change to an erased person, so they cannot be re-activated (updates/9039). Status is now done, proven by a named journey over the launch HTTP doors.

agentUpdateInstructions: Upgrade from 0.4.0 by merging this release into your checkout, keeping your customisations and every applied migration byte. Back up first: stop rer dev and run rer export --output exports/workspace.rer; for a hosted installation, sign in as the owner and download Settings → Export your installation → Download verified archive. Run rer install with the pinned @runeditrun/rer 0.2.80, then rer dev (local) or rer deploy (hosted). This release adds 37 migrations: core/1290 and core/1300 in the core group, then updates/9039 to updates/9084 in the updates group, each applied once in file order; never reset populated data to upgrade. Breaking for integrations only: updates/9079 types the fields of the Launch readiness tables at /api/v1/apps/00000000000000000000000700/entities/*, so percent, single select, relation, person, money and due-at values change shape as the 0.5.0 CHANGELOG entry lists; no stored row changes. Company sign-in, Slack and chat apps, Twilio SMS, Google Calendar sync, personal file stores and warehouse exports stay off until an owner configures each one. CONTRACT.md was rewritten into Core and Agent surface targets and is the source for what is done, partial or missing; this release adds 86 clause IDs and removes none.
publicReleaseNotes:
Cradle 0.5.0 releases the work on main since 0.4.0.

The minute cron and every queue run now read a flat handful of D1 rows however much history the install holds (about 90 rows a run, down from about 10,000 at 30 days of defaults), so a small company on Workers Free no longer spends its account's daily D1 read allowance on Cradle alone.

Date-and-time fields are shown and entered in each viewer's own time zone. Erasing an operator is final.

The release also carries the schema and current work for Trash (records, views, tables and fields), record templates and template buttons, guests, Launch comments in the record thread, warehouse exports (CSV or Parquet, to R2 or another destination), opt-in company sign-in with SAML and SCIM, sheet sources for import, automation test runs, personal file stores, Google Calendar record sync, Twilio SMS, and Slack and chat apps. Integrations stay off until an owner configures them; CONTRACT.md says what is done, partial or missing for each.

Breaking for integrations: the fields of the Launch readiness tables are now typed, so the Records API returns percent, single select, relation, person, money and due-at values in new shapes. No stored row changes. The CHANGELOG lists each shape.

Adds 37 migrations, all listed in RELEASE.json. Cradle now pins rer 0.2.80.
